name: Richil Emaiyu
source:
A childish girl who you just cant seem to hate.
A year ago she began learning magic from her mentor Deana and became a court magician apprentice.
Because they are both apprentices at the same time and because of their mentors her and the protagonist are rivals.
She has a lazy side where she tries to steal the protagonists 'magic stone' with card battles.
